blocks.text: Yeh chapter physics ke do bare hisson par baat karta hai: transverse waves ki polarization aur gravitational waves. Hum in dono ko ek ek kar ke parhenge.
Polarization ke hawale se physical optics yeh dekhti hai ke light waves kaise behave karti hain aur maadde (matter) ke saath un ka kya taalluq hota hai.

Interference aur diffraction sabit karte hain ke light ek wave hai. Lekin in se yeh pata nahi chalta ke light waves longitudinal hain ya transverse. Polarization se pata chalta hai ke light waves transverse hain (un ki vibration chalne ki simt ke perpendicular hoti hai).

Transverse mechanical waves mein, jaise khinchi hui rassi (string) par banne wali waves, medium ke particles ki vibration wave ke aage barhne (propagation) ki simt ke perpendicular hoti hai. Yeh vibration vertical (oopar-neeche), horizontal (daen-baen) ya kisi aur simt mein ho sakti hai (Fig. 8.1). In mein se har soorat mein wave polarized kehlati hai. Plane of polarization woh plane (satah) hai jis mein particles ki vibration ki simt aur wave ke aage barhne ki simt dono hon.

blocks.alt: Do taar, har ek neeche baen sire par haath mein pakri hui aur tirchhi daen oopar jati hui. Oopar wale taar (a) par lehar oopar neeche hai, saath khara dohra teer; neeche wale taar (b) par lehar ufuqi (horizontal) satah mein daen baen hai, saath para dohra teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.1: Taar par transverse waves, (a) amudi (vertical) satah mein aur (b) ufuqi satah mein polarized (kitab ki Figure 8.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono rassiyon par wave rassi ke perpendicular hilti hai, isi liye yeh transverse hai. (a) mein particles sirf oopar-neeche hilte hain, to plane of polarization vertical hai; (b) mein sirf daen-baen, to plane horizontal hai. Jis wave ki vibration ek hi plane mein rahe woh polarized kehlati hai.

Jhoolte (oscillating) charge se banne wali light wave mein electric field vector E baar baar (periodically) badalta hai, aur us ke saath magnetic field vector B hota hai; E aur B ek doosre se 90° par hain. Aam light mein vibration har mumkin plane mein hoti hai; aisi light unpolarized kehlati hai. Agar vibration sirf ek plane tak mehdood (confined) ho to light polarized kehlati hai. Unpolarized light Fig. 8.2 mein dikhayi gayi hai.
Unpolarized light ki misalein: dhoop (sunlight), incandescent (filament wale) bulb, fluorescent bulb, mom batti ya aag ki roshni.

blocks.alt: Neeche baen jalta hua incandescent bulb. Bulb se ek lakeer oopar ek nuqte tak jati hai jahan se peele teer har simt mein bahar ki taraf hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.2: Incandescent bulb ki unpolarized light ki vibrations har simt mein hoti hain (kitab ki Figure 8.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Peele teer electric field E ki vibration ki simtein hain. Bulb ki light mein E har simt mein hilta hai; koi ek simt khaas nahi. Isi ko unpolarized light kehte hain.

Polarization woh amal (process) hai jis se light waves ki electric aur magnetic vibrations ko sirf ek plane tak mehdood kar diya jata hai. Yeh khoobi sirf transverse waves, jaise light, mein hoti hai. Longitudinal waves, jaise sound, mein polarization nahi hoti (un ki vibration chalne ki simt ke saath hi hoti hai, is liye koi plane chunne ka sawal nahi).
Unpolarized light ko polarized kaise karein?
Unpolarized light ko in tareeqon se polarized kiya ja sakta hai:

items: Light ko polarizing filter (maslan polaroid sheet) se guzar kar.
Polarizing beam splitter istemal kar ke.
Kuch khaas optical crystals ya materials (maslan calcite, quartz) istemal kar ke.

blocks.text: Sab se aam tareeqa yeh hai ke unpolarized light ko polarizing filter (jaise polarizing beam splitter ya polaroid sheet) se guzara jaye. Filter se sirf woh electric field vector guzarta hai jo filter ke axis ke parallel ho; baqi sab ruk jate hain. Is tarah nikalne wali light polarized ho jati hai (Fig. 8.3).

blocks.alt: Ek shua (neeli lakeer) daen neeche ki taraf jati hai. Filter se pehle surkh E teer kai simton mein hain. Shua khari lakeeron aur khare axis teer wale polarized filter se guzarti hai. Filter ke baad sirf ek khara surkh E teer hai. Labels: E, Polarized filter, Axis, Polarization direction, Direction of ray.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.3: Polarized light ki simt (kitab ki Figure 8.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Filter ka axis vertical hai, is liye E ka sirf woh hissa guzarta hai jo axis ke parallel hai. Baqi simton wale hisse ruk jate hain. Filter ke baad E sirf ek (vertical) simt mein hilta hai: yeh polarization direction hai, aur ray apni simt mein chalti rehti hai.
Saada alfaaz mein: unpolarized light ko polarized light mein badalne ka amal polarization kehlata hai.

blocks.title: Polarization ki bunyad
blocks.text: Light waves ke electric field vector E ka kisi ek khaas simt mein hona hi polarization ki bunyad (basis) hai.

blocks.prompt: Polarization ki tareef karein. Light polarized ho sakti hai magar sound kyun nahi (MCQ 8.1; comprehensive question 8.1)?
blocks.explanation: Polarization light ki electric aur magnetic vibrations ko ek plane tak mehdood karna hai. Sirf transverse waves (jin ki vibration chalne ki simt ke perpendicular ho) ki vibration ka plane chuna ja sakta hai; light transverse hai, is liye polarized ho sakti hai. Sound longitudinal hai: us ki vibration chalne ki simt ke saath hai, is liye usay kisi plane tak mehdood nahi kiya ja sakta. MCQ 8.1 ka jawab (b) hai: light ka kisi khaas plane mein vibrate karna.

items: Interference aur diffraction batate hain ke light wave hai; polarization batati hai ke woh transverse hai. Plane of polarization = vibration ki simt + chalne ki simt wala plane.

Unpolarized light har plane mein vibrate karti hai (dhoop, bulb, mom batti); polarized sirf ek mein. Tareeqe: polarizing filter (polaroid), polarizing beam splitter, crystals (calcite, quartz); filter sirf apne axis ke parallel E guzarta hai.
